title: Uruguay
goal: Read how Uruguay's regime, after militarily defeating the Tupamaros by 1972, controlled public life through obligatory party affiliation and fear of surveillance, and was surprised when citizens rejected its new constitution.

items: Explain who was required to join the Partido Colorado.
Describe the Tupamaros' military situation by 1972.
Describe how people avoided talking about politics for fear of surveillance.
Explain why the regime did not expect citizens to reject the new constitution.
Use por su parte to introduce a new case in a comparison.
